narrative.details: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
narrative.objectives: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.
narrative.offerRewardText: Heartweaver? Heartweaver...Oh! Little Jeremy Heartweaver. He was brought in years ago after the attack on Lordaeron. Lost both of his parents in the attack, poor thing.He was actually adopted not too long ago by a sweet woman out in Duskwood.
narrative.requestItemsText: What is it, Big? What are you looking for?
